unit: one comparator class unit (item × compared class)
label: correct iff the comparator judgement equals the gold judgement; `unsure` / parse failure -> Abstain band (counted as not answered)
method: L2-regularised logistic regression, C = 1.0 (penalty 1/(2C)·||w||², intercept unpenalised), features standardised with the training data's mean and sd, Newton solver (numpy), 50 iterations max, tol 1e-10

M2.name: comparator-intrinsic
M2.fit: development set: 30-item IRR consensus, 92 comparator units
M2.use: Showcase, product badges (Obligation Explorer, assistant, live mode, review queue)

M1.name: full signals (cross-validated on gold)
M1.fit: 5-fold cross-fitting on gold, grouped by item; fold assignment = numpy default_rng(20261003).permutation over sorted item ids, fold = position mod 5
M1.use: research views only, labelled 'cross-validated on gold'

merge_rule: a High or Low band with n < 20 on gold is merged into Medium; if Medium then has n < 20 it is hidden (R14)
operating_point: answer only at High (fixed here, before any gold evaluation)
honesty_rule: bands are labelled 'experimental' and kept out of the Showcase if the High band's Wilson 95% lower bound is not above the Low band's point accuracy, or if ECE (10 equal-width bins) > 0.10
metrics: selective-prediction curve (accuracy vs coverage, coverage over all 412 units)
dropped_signal: BM25/dense agreement on the matched paragraph: no per-unit rankings stored (DECISIONS D-04, gap G-23)
